Joyce Center|Purcell Pavilion at the Joyce Center]] |champion= |bowl=[[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result=Round of 64 }} {{2009–10 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2009–10 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Notre Dame]] in the 2009–2010 [[NCAA Division I]] basketball season. The Fighting Irish were coached by [[Mike Brey]] and played their home games at the [[Edmund P. Joyce Center]] in [[Notre Dame, Indiana|Notre Dame, IN]]. The Fighting Irish are members of the [[Big East Conference (1979–2013)|Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 23–12, 10–8 in Big East play. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2010 Big East men's basketball tournament]] before losing to [[2009–10 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|West Virginia]]. They received an at–large bid to the [[2010 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]], earning a #6 seed in the South Region.
